scope: Public repair for the Google sign-in control so the server-clickable fallback and the Google Identity Services mount host coexist until client handoff.

repair.observed_defect: The server fallback was returned without the native Google button host, so the client effect could observe a null mount ref and never complete its Google Identity Services handoff.
repair.new_behavior: The server fallback remains a direct canonical authorization link while an inert, mounted native host is kept behind it. After Google Identity Services is ready, the fallback is removed and the existing native button is revealed.
repair.unchanged_boundaries: The canonical OAuth route, Better Auth session flow, email auth, tenant derivation, privacy consent, D1/R2 bindings, account policy, and frozen visual routes are unchanged.

not_proven: A browser-completed Google Identity Services handoff, account selection, callback, or session on Version 131.
A completed email registration, verification, reset, and sign-in replay on Version 131.
Current Version 131 A/B tenant isolation or physical second-device history readback.
